# Community & support

| | Where |
| --- | --- |
| 🐞 Bug reports | [GitHub Issues → Bug report](https://github.com/LightSideKittens/LightSideEcosystem/issues/new?template=1-bug-report.yml) |
| ✨ Feature requests | [GitHub Issues → Feature request](https://github.com/LightSideKittens/LightSideEcosystem/issues/new?template=2-feature-request.yml) |
| 💬 Questions, help and discussion | [Discord](https://discord.gg/ynRHp3wRmb) |
| 🔒 Security vulnerabilities | [Private report](https://github.com/LightSideKittens/LightSideEcosystem/security/advisories/new), see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) |
| 📖 Documentation and licences | [unity.lightside.media](https://unity.lightside.media) |

The issue forms ask for the product and its version, the Unity version, the platforms, the steps to reproduce and the logs. Every report is labelled with its product and platforms automatically.

Never post access tokens. Registry URLs in `manifest.json` and `.upmconfig.toml` contain your personal token (`lst_…`); remove them from logs, files and screenshots.
